topic: How Fees and Expenses Affect Your Investment Portfolio
source_evidence: Other brokerage fees. In addition to commissions, a broker-dealer may charge certain other fees, such as fees for: use of certain trading platforms, account maintenance, account inactivity, not maintaining a minimum balance, account transfers, account closings, or wire transfers.
answer: Brokerage account fees can include commissions as well as charges for services or account features, such as account maintenance, inactivity, transfers, or wire transfers. Some fees are charged when you make a transaction; others, such as an annual maintenance fee, may be charged regularly even when you do not trade. These costs reduce the money in your portfolio that can earn a return. Read the firm’s fee schedule or disclosures, and review your statements so you understand what you are being charged.
